Builds and configures the Firedancer tile topology, links, workspaces, and tile settings.

# Purpose
This file builds and configures the Firedancer runtime topology. It creates the `fd_topo_t` object, defines workspaces, links, and tiles, and connects the main processing path for gossip, repair, replay, execution, packing, banking, proof-of-history, signing, QUIC, verification, and optional features such as snapshots, archiving, shred capture, RPC, and GUI support. It also resolves network entrypoints and peer addresses, parses IP and port values, and sets CPU affinity for tiles when the configuration does not use automatic layout.

The file also assigns per-tile configuration data from `config_t` into each tile state in [`fd_topo_configure_tile`](<#fd_topo_configure_tile>). This includes network ports, identity and vote key paths, snapshot source settings, replay and execution cache object IDs, bundle settings, shred destinations, GUI settings, and archiver settings. In addition, it creates shared objects such as `funk`, `banks`, `progcache`, `txncache`, `fec_sets`, `store`, and `bank_busy`, then records their object IDs in the topology properties so other tiles can use them.
